Who We Are

ADVARNA Development & Manufacturing

ADVARNA is a company specialized in the development and manufacturing of wireless measurement solutions, dedicated to structural and geotechnical monitoring in the field of civil engineering and industry.

Founded in 2021, ADVARNA aims to meet client needs in the field of civil engineering, with the goal of becoming a reference in the coming years.

ADVARNA offers several types of wireless modules that interface with different types of sensors. The communication technologies used can be SIGFOX, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, and M2M.

Our proposed solutions interface with sensors using the best technologies on the market, in order to have total confidence in our measurements.

Our Values

Expertise

Our company is led by two managers with expertise in physical measurement, sensors, networks, and instrumentation. We listen to your needs and support you in your instrumentation projects.

Partnership of Trust

We are committed to supporting our clients throughout their project. From recommending the type of wireless solution to assisting with installation when needed. ADVARNA operates throughout France.

Reactivity

Our company is able to adapt to any situation or problem in the fastest and most qualitative way possible. We respond quickly to your technical and commercial requests.

Innovation

Innovation is the DNA of our company. We maintain constant market surveillance to improve our products. We also listen to our clients to support them in their new wireless solution development processes.

Why Monitor

The Advantages of Monitoring

Structural monitoring provides significant benefits for infrastructure management, from cost savings to enhanced safety and regulatory compliance.

Cost Reduction

Optimize maintenance operations and reduce intervention costs through predictive monitoring and early detection of structural issues.

-40%Maintenance costs

Lifespan Extension

Extend the service life of your structures by continuously monitoring their health and addressing issues before they become critical.

+25%Structure lifespan

Safety Improvement

Enhance the safety of users and operators by detecting anomalies early and preventing catastrophic failures.

99%Uptime reliability

Regulatory Compliance

Meet regulatory requirements for structural monitoring with certified, traceable measurement systems and automated reporting.

100%Compliance rate
